AC69

**Richardson Co. Nebraska**

Found half-submerged in soil on Northwest-facing slope in mixed Oak/Hickory woodland draw.
Nearby Trees: Ironwood, Shagbark Hickory, Chinkapin Oak, Northern Red Oak, Bitternut Hickory, Elm and Red Mulberry.
